name: Groq
description: Groq describes itself as a cloud provider focused on fast AI inference, built around its own LPU hardware.
strengths: Specialised inference hardware (LPU), per the vendor
limitations: The pricing page we read showed no plan names or per-token rates, so we do not publish prices

notes: The page we read described the company but listed no prices. Check the official page for current plans and per-token rates.

profile.headline: Fast LLM inference through an OpenAI-compatible API

capabilities.title: Call models with familiar SDKs
capabilities.text: Point an OpenAI SDK at Groq's base URL and call a model.

capabilities.title: Generate and transcribe
capabilities.text: Text generation, speech to text, text to speech, OCR and image recognition, and reasoning.

capabilities.title: Return structured results
capabilities.text: Structured Outputs, plus Prompt Caching and Content Moderation.

capabilities.title: Give models tools
capabilities.text: Tool Use, built-in Code Execution and Browser Search for GPT OSS models, Remote Tools and MCP, and Google Workspace connectors.

featureCards.name: Service tiers
featureCards.text: Performance Tier, Flex Processing and Batch Processing.

featureCards.name: Coding integrations
featureCards.text: Factory Droid, OpenCode, Kilo Code, Roo Code and Cline.

featureCards.name: Production readiness
featureCards.text: A production checklist, latency guidance, security onboarding and Prometheus metrics.

featureCards.name: Account controls
featureCards.text: Spend Limits, Projects, Model Permissions and Your Data settings.

featureCards.name: Developer resources
featureCards.text: SDK libraries, API reference, models list, rate limits, error codes and a changelog.

audienceDetail.text: The API is OpenAI-compatible, so existing code needs little change. The page does not name an audience, so these groups follow from what it documents.
Tool use, MCP and connectors are documented.
Spend limits, projects, model permissions and a production checklist are documented.

scenarios.title: Swap an existing OpenAI call
scenarios.text: Change the base URL and key, and keep your SDK.

scenarios.title: Transcribe or speak
scenarios.text: Use the speech to text and text to speech endpoints.

scenarios.title: Run code or search as part of an answer
scenarios.text: Use the built-in tools with GPT OSS models.

scenarios.title: Process work in bulk
scenarios.text: Use Batch Processing instead of live calls.
